meta.title: Big Hal's car lot
meta.notes: The owner's new script (decision d13-the-sell): a sell that sets up the punchline, one generation per sentence. Line 1 is Take 5's opening (Take 4's clean source) cut 0.21 s after "tri-county area!", before "No money down". Lines 2-6 are new takes, each started from a still of the approved footage (hal5/stills): medium close-up, medium by the hood, wide, medium by the hood, medium close-up. Line 5's palm lands flat on the hood 0.39 s after "car"; its own thump, from the same take, is laid 0.07 s early so it lands on the contact frame and rings on into line 6. Line 6's voice is one take (hal7-guarantee4-t3) heard whole; its picture cuts, between "guaranteed" and "to get", to a silent insert of his hand counting one, two, three (hal7-count-t1), laid 1.00 s behind the voice so each finger lands on its item, because no take that showed his face counted in step (every one ran the count ahead of the words). The insert is split in the two silent gaps only to lift "four seats" (+2.4 dB more) and "a steering wheel" (+3.9 dB more) to the level of "four doors"; its picture runs on in step. Lines 7-8 are Take 6's accepted wc take exactly as Take 6 played it. Every shot's whole sound is faded 12 ms at both ends, as the script mixed it. Every new sentence is brought to about -22.5 dBFS speech-band RMS, Take 5's opening's level. Graphics are our PNGs on their words: NO MONEY DOWN and $99 A MONTH on line 4, FOUR DOORS!, FOUR SEATS! and STEERING WHEEL! as each is said, then Take 6's WHEELS INCLUDED!*, fine print, COME ON DOWN, phone and route. Rendered by hal7/edit.mjs.

lines.text: Howdy folks, Big Hal here at Big Hal's, the biggest lot in the tri-county area!

lines.speaker: Big Hal
lines.text: Now, those fancy dealerships'll charge you for all kinds of extras.

lines.speaker: Big Hal
lines.text: Not Big Hal. I keep it simple, and I pass the savings on to you.

lines.speaker: Big Hal
lines.text: That's how I can do no money down, and ninety-nine a month!

lines.speaker: Big Hal
lines.text: And I personally hand-inspect every car.

lines.speaker: Big Hal
lines.text: At Big Hal's, you're guaranteed to get four doors! Four seats! A steering wheel!
